environment.description: Same application deployed identically on EC2 behind an ALB, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK for matching), specifically SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING and GenericLFI_QUERYSTRING active; (2) Priority 200: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with all rules in default action — this group uses SQLi detection on query string parameters, body, URI path, and headers via AWS's proprietary transformation pipeline including URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, and COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE applied before matching; (3) Priority 300: A custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the SQLi rule group has been actively blocking requests in production for 90+ days with zero false-positive overrides configured. The WAFv2 is deployed in the same region as the ALB with logging to S3 enabled.

config.rule_group_2: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, priority 200, default actions, inspects QUERY_STRING with URL_DECODE+HTML_ENTITY_DECODE+COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE transforms
config.network: public ALB, SG allows 443 inbound from any
